anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Not 'first was the Word' but 'in the beginning was the Word'.

pass_a_gloss: Wherefore also into his world coming to be, John does not say: first was the Word, but in beginning was the Word.
pass_b_english: [Therefore] also when he comes into his world John does not say: "the Word [was] first," but "in the beginning was [the] Word."
source_text: [διὸ κ]αὶ εἰς κό[σ]μον αὐτοῦ γινομέν[ου Ἰ]ωάννης οὐ λέγε[ι]· "πρῶτος [ἦν ὁ λ]όγος", ἀλλὰ "ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦ[ν ὁ] λόγος".
